notes: *as in* is taken as one compound rendering of the kaf under rule 30; giving *in* to the noun as a supplied function word under rule 33 is the competing reading.

אֵין takes the whole recast frame *have no*, headed on the negation, leaving its לְ and suffix with nothing (rules 43, 50); putting *have* on the possessive לְ under rule 43's verbless-clause sentence is the competing reading, since the existential still keeps *no* when the word is dropped.
